envelope.description: Move the area helpers to the shared scope module and add scopeArea

body.title: Move the area helpers to the shared scope module and add scopeArea
body.summary: Move graphRepoOf, inAreaOf and docsAreaOf from src/analyze/runtimes/shared/task-scope.ts to src/analyze/context/scope.ts, re-exporting them from the old path so task runtimes are unchanged; add scopeArea (dir, file or symbol area, null for workspace, repo and connection scopes) and scopeAreaKey (the serialised area, or 'repo') built on them.
acceptanceChecks: task runtimes still pass their existing tests through the re-exports
scopeArea of a symbol scope is the one entity and null for a workspace, repo or connection scope
scopeAreaKey differs for two different modules

tests.name: scope-area.test.ts: graphRepoOf, inAreaOf, docsAreaOf and scopeArea behave as pinned after the move; scopeArea is null for workspace, repo and connection scopes and the one entity for a symbol; scopeAreaKey differs per area
